paragraphs: {brand} is online booking for any business that sells its time: salons, dentists, tutors, gyms, mechanics and more. Clients see the free times and book in a minute. Businesses get a calendar, a list of requests and their clients in one place.
It's free for clients and for businesses. You pay the business at the place, as you always have.

sections.heading: Where it stands
paragraphs: {brand} is in development.
It's being built for Turkmenistan first.

sections.heading: Who runs it
paragraphs: {brand} is built and run by {operator}, {country}.

sections.heading: Booking
paragraphs: Find a place by search, category or the map, pick a service and a free time, and send the booking. You sign in with your phone number; there's no password.
Some businesses confirm at once. Others answer your request first, and you see the answer in My bookings.

sections.heading: Changing or cancelling
paragraphs: Open the booking in My bookings. Each business sets how long before the visit you can change or cancel for free; the booking says so. If it's too late to do it here, call the business.

sections.heading: Reviews
paragraphs: After a visit you can write a review, for up to 30 days. You can change it for 7 days after writing it. Businesses can't delete reviews, but they can reply or report one to the {brand} team.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: Change your name, phone number and language in your profile. You can delete your account there too: upcoming bookings are cancelled, and your account, favourites and reviews are deleted.

sections.heading: For businesses
paragraphs: Set up your business in the {brand} Business app: the services, the hours, the team and how you take bookings. The {brand} team checks each new business before it opens to clients.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: {brand} is run by {operator}, {country}. In this policy, “we” means {brand}.

sections.heading: The site is in development
paragraphs: {brand} is in development. The sign-in code shows on the screen instead of arriving by SMS, and no SMS is sent. Anyone who types a phone number can sign in as that number, so please don't put anything real or private here, and don't use a number you wouldn't want someone else to type.
This policy will change before {brand} opens for real, and each market gets its own version, checked by a lawyer there.

sections.heading: What we keep
items: Your account: your phone number, name, language and photo, if you add one.
What you do on {brand}: your bookings, notes on them, reviews and favourite places.
What business teams enter: the business's details and photos, their team, and their client records, which can include names, phone numbers and notes about clients.
Technical data: your internet address, browser and the pages you ask for, in the server's logs and in the limits that stop abuse.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: To sign you in, to make and manage bookings, to show a business the bookings made with it, and to keep the service working and safe. We don't sell your data, we don't show advertising, and we don't use analytics or tracking.

sections.heading: Who sees it
items: A business you book with sees your name, your phone number and your booking, and keeps its own record of your visits.
Visitors see your reviews under your first name and initial.
The {brand} team sees what it needs to check businesses and reported reviews.

Services that help run {brand}: the company hosting our server, the map and address-search providers, which see your internet address when a map or an address search loads, and Cloudflare, for the domain and e-mail.

sections.heading: Where it's kept
paragraphs: On a server in the European Union.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Until you delete your account. Then your upcoming bookings are cancelled, and your account, favourites and reviews are deleted. Each business keeps its own visit records, no longer linked to a {brand} account. Copies taken before an update may keep your data a while longer.
While {brand} is in development, its data can be reset at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies and storage
paragraphs: We use cookies only to keep you signed in. Your browser also remembers small conveniences, such as the city you chose. Nothing here tracks you across other sites.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can change your details and delete your account in your profile. To ask what we hold about you, for a copy of it, or for anything else in this policy, write to us at the address below.

sections.heading: What {brand} is
paragraphs: {brand} connects clients with businesses that take bookings. It's run by {operator}, {country}. Using {brand} means you accept these terms. It's free, and no payment goes through it: you pay the business at the place.

sections.heading: The site is in development
paragraphs: {brand} is in development. The service may change, stop or lose data at any time, and we make no promise that it works.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You sign in with your phone number. Use a number that's yours, and keep your details true. You're responsible for what's done from your account.

sections.heading: Bookings
paragraphs: A booking is between you and the business. {brand} passes it on but isn't a party to it. The business sets its own rules, such as how long before a visit you can cancel for free, and it can confirm or decline a request. After repeated no-shows, a business can limit you to booking by phone.

sections.heading: Reviews
paragraphs: A review must be honest and about a visit you really made. The {brand} team can remove one that's false, insulting, about another business, or spam.

sections.heading: Businesses
paragraphs: A business is responsible for what it publishes and for the service it gives. The {brand} team checks a new business before it opens to clients, and can hide or close one, telling its owner why.

sections.heading: What's not allowed
paragraphs: Don't make fake bookings, misuse someone else's details, send abuse, copy the site's data in bulk, or try to break or get around how {brand} works. We can limit or close an account that does.

sections.heading: Our responsibility
paragraphs: {brand} is provided as it is. As far as the law allows, we aren't responsible for a business's services, for a booking that doesn't go as planned, or for losses from the service being unavailable.

sections.heading: Ending and changes
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time in your profile. We may change these terms, and the date at the top says when we last did.
These terms are under the law of {country}.
